svg.title: 4/3 solenoid spool valve NG6 – section and spool centre types (example)
svg.text: 4/3 directional spool valve NG6 (ISO 4401-03 / CETOP 03) – section in centre position + centre types
Solenoid pushes the spool against the centring spring. Spool clearance ≈ 4–10 µm radial → always some leakage (5–50 cm³/min): a spool valve cannot hold a load.
mounting face ISO 4401-03 (4 × M5 bolts, flatness ≤ 0.01 mm/100 mm)
Section in centre position: all ports blocked (closed centre)
Solenoid a ON → spool moves RIGHT → P→A, B→T (cylinder extends)
Solenoid b ON → spool moves LEFT → P→B, A→T (cylinder retracts)
Both OFF → springs centre the spool → centre function (table)
Example type codes (read the SYMBOL, not the letter):
Atos DHI, Danfoss (Vickers) DG4V-3, HAWE NG6.
NG6: P, A, B 31.5–35 MPa · T 16–21 MPa (check)
Δp ≈ 0.5–1.0 MPa per path at 60 L/min
Centre types (middle box of a 4/3 valve) – what pump and load do in neutral
rapid advance of a differential cylinder
soft stop of motors, smooth start
Small box: A, B on top · P, T below. Letters differ per maker – always compare the drawn symbol in the catalogue.
